source: Reference bench: five frozen states built from one real Windows Calculator window (standard mode), captured through a UI Automation tree. The element tables are verbatim; DISPLAY and the action history reconstruct what a live loop would have seen at that point. Run it with: jev-pilot bench --fixtures examples/bench-calculator.json --chooser jev --chooser mock --repeats 3
